headline: Bitcoin fell below $65,000 on Saturday, its lowest in about three months, as more than $1B of leveraged bets were force-closed and bitcoin funds logged a second straight week of $1B-plus withdrawals.

market.asOf: CoinGecko figures at 17:00 UTC Sat 14 Nov (00:00 Sun Bangkok), as reported by Trending Topics. Prices have moved since; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear, but indexes differ: CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index showed 16 out of 100 at about 20:05 UTC, while Trending Topics reported a reading of 13 on Saturday (20 on Friday, 28 on Thursday).

stories.title: Bitcoin slips below $65,000, a three-month low, as $1B of leveraged bets are wiped out
stories.summary: Selling carried on through Saturday. Bitcoin went under $65,000 for the first time in about three months, and ether, XRP and solana fell even harder. Most of the losses hit traders who had borrowed to bet on rising prices; their positions were closed automatically.
points: Bitcoin traded at 64,995 in USDT (a dollar-pegged stablecoin) on Saturday morning US time, down 4.86% on the day, per TokenPost (11:56am ET).
At 17:00 UTC CoinGecko showed bitcoin down 13.59% in seven days, ether down 18.29% and solana down 18.95%, per Trending Topics.

About $1.01B of crypto bets were liquidated (force-closed) in 24 hours, 93% of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data reported by Trending Topics; another count, CoinGlass data analysed by Altcoin Buzz and cited by CryptoTicker, put it at about $1.23B.
Bitcoin is about 49% below its record of about $126,000 from October 2025, per Trending Topics.
Traders fully expect a quarter-point Fed rate hike at the 8-9 December meeting, per CME FedWatch data cited by Bitcoin Magazine.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose over $1B for a second straight week and are now negative for 2026
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, the way many Americans hold bitcoin in a brokerage account, saw more money leave than arrive for a second week running. When fund holders sell, the fund sells bitcoin, removing buying support. Ether funds also lost money on the week, though their daily losing streak ended on Friday.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs had $1.07B of net outflows in the week to 13 November, after $1.28B the week before, per The Block.
That leaves bitcoin ETFs about $1.98B in net outflows for 2026 so far, per The Block.
Friday saw $185.5M leave, led by BlackRock's IBIT ($143.5M) and Fidelity's FBTC ($41.9M), per The Block.
Spot ether ETFs lost $398.9M on the week, their seventh losing week in a row, but took in $2.4M on Friday, ending a six-day outflow streak, per The Block.

stories.title: Strategy's 850,364 bitcoin are now worth less than it paid for them
stories.summary: With bitcoin well below Strategy's average purchase price, the biggest corporate bitcoin holder now shows a paper loss on its whole stack.
points: Strategy holds 850,364 BTC bought at an average of $75,456 each, about $64.16B in total, per Bitcoin.com News.
That put it about $7.2B underwater, with the holding valued at about $56.9B, per Bitcoin.com News.
Its latest disclosed move was buying 1,036 BTC for $81.9M, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Bitcoin mining gets 9% easier
briefs.summary: Mining difficulty fell 9.13% to 134.82T as computing power on the network dropped to about 907 EH/s, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: BNB falls below $600
briefs.summary: BNB dropped to $584, down 7.3% in 24 hours and about 23% since the 29 October Binance hack, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Louisiana's attorney general hits back at the CFTC
briefs.summary: After the CFTC sued the state over prediction markets, Louisiana's AG called CFTC chair Michael Selig an "obsequious standard bearer" for the industry; a hearing is set for 30 November, per The Block.

briefs.title: Options hedging may be making swings bigger
briefs.summary: Options dealers are positioned so their hedging adds to price moves for bitcoin between about $58,000 and $72,000, per Greeks.Live data reported by CoinDesk.

briefs.title: JPMorgan raises its Strategy stake
briefs.summary: JPMorgan's latest quarterly filing shows its Strategy holding up 36% to 848,932 shares, per The Block.

briefs.title: Meta tests a prediction-market app
briefs.summary: Called "Takes", it is being tested with employees and uses points rather than real money, per the WSJ via The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin mined in 2010 moves
briefs.summary: Two addresses untouched for over 16 years moved a combined 100 BTC, each from 50 BTC mining rewards in September 2010, per The Block.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: ARB, SEI, STRK, CRO, ZK, PENGU, ZRO, KAITO, AKE, MORPHO
calendar.note: ARB, SEI and STRK unlock on Sunday 15 November. See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence.
At Olympia London, the first Breakpoint held in the UK, per Solana Compass.
Consensus 19, per Economic Weekly; prior 25.5, per investingLive.

calendar.event: Fed Chair Warsh gives opening remarks
calendar.note: At the Productivity and Jobs Task Force conference at the San Francisco Fed, per the Fed's calendar.

Forecasts differ: +0.2% per Newsquawk and Economic Weekly, 0% per Forex Fundamentals; prior +0.8%. Industrial production at 9:15am ET (consensus +0.1%, per Economic Weekly). Home Depot reports before the open.
Call at 5pm ET (05:00 Wed Bangkok), per Nvidia. Revenue forecasts: about $109.2B per LSEG data cited by IG, $108.84B per MarketPulse.

calendar.event: Fed minutes from the October meeting
calendar.note: Minutes of the 27-28 October meeting, where rates were held at 3.75-4.00% on a 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented in favour of a hike, per the Fed. Earlier, Bullish (BLSH) holds its Q3 call at 8:30am ET and Target reports before the open.

calendar.event: Anthropic shares expected to start trading
calendar.note: Nasdaq ticker ANT, range $70-78 a share, per RTTNews; up to $64.4B raised at the top of the range, per The Next Web, which expects trading to start Thursday.

calendar.event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed survey
calendar.note: Claims consensus 197,000 (prior 200,000); Philly Fed consensus 23 (prior 20.9), per Economic Weekly. Walmart reports earnings the same day. Goolsbee speaks at 12:30pm ET (00:30 Fri Bangkok), per the Chicago Fed.

calendar.event: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Nov, final)
calendar.note: Consensus 53.3, per Economic Weekly; preliminary reading 51.0 (October 48.0), per StockAnalysis. Fed's Cook speaks at 12:15pm ET (00:15 Sat Bangkok), per the Fed.
Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), press conference 2:30pm ET, per the Fed.
